title: Atrangi Document Workspace v7.2.4
notes: Fixes the crash that occurred immediately after choosing an external PDF. The Android launcher activity can now finish safely before its WebView is created, while the selected PDF is transferred to the native offline viewer with its read permission intact. PDF read failures are handled inside the viewer instead of terminating the app. Includes the responsive safe-area UI, direct sharing and stable release signing from v7.2.3.
